request.intent: Build Pokemon Leaf Green but with Pokemon Emerald overworld sprites

limitations: NPC colors adapted to existing LeafGreen shared palette; not exact Emerald colors.
LeafGreen-only identities and VS Seeker poses retain native sprites/palettes.
Spin/shake actions use safe Emerald facing/walking approximations; NPC raised-hand pose retains native art when available, otherwise faces south.
